Subject: Repair workshop room change and date update

Hello volunteers,

Thank you for supporting the Fictional Elm tool library’s repair workshop. We’re writing with an important update: the workshop will move from the east room to the west room. This room change is confirmed.

Please note that November 12, 2026 is still only a tentative workshop date, pending accessibility confirmation. The earlier November 5 date is cancelled. Once accessibility is confirmed, the coordinator will send the final date.

For now, please reply with your availability by October 30. Jo maintains the signup sheet, so your response will help keep the information current.

The workshop facilitator has not yet been assigned, and no participant trial has run. We’ll share further confirmed information when it is available.

Thanks for helping us plan carefully and make the workshop welcoming and accessible.

Warmly,
The coordination team
